title: Competition Act 2004 Section 54
source: Competition Act 2004 and CCS public guidance
summary: Mergers and acquisitions are assessed by whether they have resulted, or may be expected to result, in a substantial lessening of competition in Singapore.

title: Notification is voluntary
summary: Businesses may notify CCS where they have serious concerns that a merger may raise competition concerns in Singapore.

title: Indicative intervention thresholds
source: CCS merger overview, last updated 26 September 2025
summary: CCS is generally unlikely to intervene unless the merged entity has at least 40% market share, or 20% to 40% market share where the CR3 is at least 70%.

title: Phase 1 review
source: CCS merger notification procedures, last updated 4 May 2026
summary: A complete Form M1 triggers a preliminary Phase 1 assessment expected within 30 working days, with a streamlined 25 working day track for mergers unlikely to raise concerns.

title: Phase 2 review
source: CCS merger notification procedures, last updated 4 May 2026
summary: Where CCS has reasonable suspicion of substantial lessening of competition, Form M2 supports a more detailed Phase 2 review targeted for completion within 100 working days.

title: Confidentiality
summary: Confidential information should be identified clearly, with reasons provided for confidentiality treatment.
